edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production subject to the specific responses and objections below. These responses are based on information presently available after a reasonable inquiry and are not a representation that every potentially responsive document has been located or collected.

1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request only to the extent it seeks information protected from disclosure by the attorney-client privilege, work-product protection, or other applicable protection. Defendant further objects to any request to the extent it is unclear, overly broad, unduly burdensome, or seeks material outside the permissible scope of discovery under applicable rules. These objections are incorporated into a specific response only to the extent stated there; they are not intended as a blanket refusal to respond. Defendant will state whether responsive material is being withheld based on an objection in the applicable request-specific response.

2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving any specific objection, Defendant will produce non-privileged documents responsive to the requests as limited by the specific responses, in its possession, custody, or control, after a reasonable search. The production will be made in accordance with the applicable rules and any agreement of the parties concerning format and timing. No request-specific response or completed-search representation is made in this general section.

3. PRIVILEGE LOG. For responsive documents withheld on the basis of privilege or other protection, Defendant will provide a log identifying the withheld material to the extent and at the time required by applicable rules or agreement of the parties, unless the parties agree that a log is unnecessary or a category-based log is appropriate. Any log will not disclose the protected information itself.

4. SUPPLEMENTATION. Defendant will supplement or correct these responses as required by applicable rules. This statement does not waive any objection or impose a duty beyond that provided by the applicable rules.
